pipeline: PyCOLMAP 3.11.1 sparse followed by OpenMVS 2.4.0 CPU dense, mesh, refine, texture
composition: fresh sparse producer and separate native dense continuation
inputs: 60 original Berkeley NP3 cracker-box RGB photos and photo-derived coarse masks; Berkeley rig metadata and Google scanner mesh excluded from reconstruction

score.reference: independent Google scanner mesh, used only after reconstruction
score.metric: surface F1 at 1% of reference bounding-box diagonal
score.interpretation: Post hoc reference fit and conditional shared-gauge diagnostic; neither establishes physical metric accuracy or object-quality acceptance

license_scope: OpenMVS AGPL-3.0 evaluation oracle; no approval to bundle or ship its binary
